user.title: Atlantic heat-pump controller
user.description: Select the Atlantic climate controlled by this integration and the room climates representing the valves. The Atlantic climate must provide its current temperature.

data.idle_offset: Offset when there is no room deficit (°C)

data_description.deadband: Room temperature gaps up to this value use the idle offset instead of increasing the heat-pump target. Default: 0.2 °C.
data_description.delta_max: Maximum amount added to the Atlantic climate's current temperature when rooms need heat. Default: 6 °C.
data_description.idle_offset: Temperature offset used when a room is in heating mode but its temperature gap is within the deadband. A negative value lowers the heat-pump target. Default: -0.5 °C.

error.no_rooms: Select at least one room climate.
error.target_is_room: The Atlantic climate cannot also be selected as a room climate.
